query.title: Search query
query.description: Plain-language product description, e.g. "emerald satin midi dress that converts to a skirt with phone pockets".
query.prefill: backpack with a built-in laptop stand

spec.title: Product spec
spec.description: Optional structured spec (category, color, features, target_price_usd, ...). Scoring uses it to name what each listing is missing.

sources.title: Stores
sources.description: Which stores to search, in parallel.

maxPerSource.title: Results per store
maxPerSource.description: Keep this small to save credits.

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout per store (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: A store that doesn't answer in time is skipped, not fatal.

minScore.title: Minimum score to keep
minScore.description: 80+ means it exists, 50-79 is close, under 50 is dropped by default.

sourceActors.title: Store actor overrides (advanced)
sourceActors.description: Swap the Store actor used for a source: { "etsy": { "actorId": "user/actor", "input": { "search": "{{query}}", "maxItems": "{{max}}" } } }. {{query}}, {{max}} and {{queryEncoded}} are substituted.
